Steps with two long sloping steel handrails going down into the water from the north-east corner of the deck. Placed in the short straight-sided stub on the north-east of the surveyed pool outline, which is the only part of the outline that matches (the aerial shows a dark curved mark in the same stub). Two-hoop steel ladder on the deck tongue that pushes into the pool from the west (the notch in the west side of the surveyed outline), on its south edge about 0.5 m back from the tip. Rays from IMG_2188 (compass 171 deg) and from south-pool-02 both land within 0.5 m of this point; also the far-centre ladder in south-pool-01.

Steel ladder at the south end of the straight edge on the east side of the pointed deck tongue that enters the pool from the south (the V notch in the surveyed outline), i.e. the south-west corner of the south-east lobe. White louvred box about 1.5 m long with a blue notice on it, standing on the deck at the base of the pointed south tongue, just behind (south of) the V of the pool edge. Position from rays in south-pool-02, south-pool-01 and IMG_2188, which agree to under 1 m; it is on deck, about 1 m outside the water outline.

Orange life ring on a post at the north-east edge of the deck, beside the frosted screen by the steps. Ray from IMG_2188 (left of the frosted panels) crossed with the deck edge read from the aerial; the ray from south-pool-01 (ring at far right) lands about 1 m east of this.
